summary.name: Customer Experience Agent Studio
summary.one_liner: Google Cloud's Gemini-powered platform (formerly under the Dialogflow name) for building, evaluating, and deploying multimodal customer service conversational agents.
use_cases: Deploy voice agents for customer calls
Automate customer support across web, mobile, and messaging
Integrate AI agents with backend systems via connectors or MCP
Offer multilingual support in over 40 languages
Add AI agents to existing contact center (CCaaS) deployments
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a platform, powered by Gemini, that combines a low-code visual agent builder, a multimodal conversation simulator, evaluations, and tracing in one interface. It includes 35 prebuilt agent templates and AI assistance to help build agents. Agents can handle text, audio, and images across chat and voice, with human-like voices in over 40 languages and direct audio-to-audio translation in 10 core languages. Out-of-the-box connectors and MCP support let agents connect to backend systems and data sources, and an omnichannel gateway covers web, mobile, voice, email, social, and apps.
notable: Gemini-powered visual low-code agent builder with simulator, evaluations, and tracing
Voice and chat agents with human-like voices in over 40 languages
Out-of-the-box connectors and MCP support for backend systems
caveats: Pricing is per session ($0.50/session for voice or chat) with limits that apply
Platform availability for mobile is implied by channel mentions only; no separate mobile platform is named
